title: Single violation: new buy stacks on an existing unfilled buy
notes: No existing IBM position, but an open unfilled order (limit buy 10 IBM @ 190.00, submitted 2026-08-26) is already on the book. A fresh 15-share buy in the same basket stacks with it -- R4 fires (disposition REPAIRED). Repair cancels the stale open order and lets the requested 15-share buy proceed as sized (no merge with the cancelled order's quantity). Post-trade: 15 sh @ 190.00 = 2850.00, 2850/50000 = 5.7% of equity (cap 15%), no R3. Buying power 60000.00 comfortably covers 2850.00, no R1. No day trade (no position being closed), no wash-sale history, market open. Single rule fires.
